agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements audited by Hadori, Sugiarto, Adi & Rekan and granted discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the allocation of Rp209.19 billion in net profit, with Rp126 billion distributed as cash dividends at Rp17 per share and the remainder as retained earnings.
Agenda #3: The Board of Directors was authorized to appoint a Public Accountant for the 2026 fiscal year audit and determine the associated fees.
Agenda #4: The meeting approved a plan to reserve 10% of the company's net profit for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026.
Agenda #5: The company was authorized to act as a guarantor for credit facilities or financing for itself, subsidiaries, or affiliates to support business expansion and investment.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved the issuance of up to 2,112,420,000 new shares with a nominal value of Rp100 per share through a Capital Increase with Pre-emptive Rights (PMHMETD I).
Agenda #7: The meeting approved the amendment of Article 4 paragraph 2 of the Articles of Association to reflect the capital increase resulting from the Rights Issue.
Agenda #8: The current composition of the Board of Directors and Commissioners was confirmed with terms of office active until April 2027.
